terrainDescription.zh: 全球最大群島國，火山地形密布，熱帶雨林與海岸線並存，爪哇等島高度都市化
terrainDescription.en: The world's largest archipelago, densely dotted with volcanoes; tropical rainforest and coastline coexist, with islands like Java highly urbanized

plate.color: white background/black text since June 2022 (black bg/white text before); yellow bg/black text for public transport

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Yellow-and-black striped bollards with a red rectangle near the top are common; black/white square or circular variants also seen; some regional variants (e.g. Central Sulawesi's black/white/yellow banding)

utilityPole.transformerMount: Poles sometimes carry the Indonesian red-white flag as stripes on the lower section; asymmetrical poles with 2 supports below the crossbar occur mainly on Sumatra and southern Sulawesi

historicalContext.zh: 印尼於1968年簽署維也納道路標誌公約但尚未正式批准，實務上道路標誌設計仍採用維也納式圖標系統。
historicalContext.en: Indonesia signed the 1968 Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals but has not formally ratified it; in practice its road signs still follow Vienna-style pictograms.
